_doc: SmartPlant Foundation (SPF) integration config — fully soft-coded. The connector reads ${ENV_VAR} placeholders at runtime so no secrets live in this file. Default mode 'dry_run' lets the UI work end-to-end without touching a real SPF tenant.

_modes_doc.dry_run: Build the SPF payload + Excel, return it to the caller WITHOUT calling SPF. Useful for QA & demos.
_modes_doc.rest_api: POST JSON + workbook to a SPF-style REST endpoint. Auth via bearer token.
_modes_doc.webhook: POST JSON + base64 workbook to a generic webhook (e.g. Power Automate, n8n).
_modes_doc.s3_dropzone: Upload the .xlsx + manifest.json to an S3 bucket/prefix that SPF watches.
_modes_doc.local_dropzone: Copy the .xlsx + manifest.json to a server-mounted folder watched by SPF Adapter.

_field_mapping_doc: Maps our master-index column keys to SPF attribute names. Add/edit entries here to support a different SPF schema without code changes. Unknown keys are passed through verbatim.
_skip_doc: Frontend-only / housekeeping columns the connector should never send to SPF.
_audit_doc: When true the connector writes a small JSON audit record to NonTeffBatch.fields_json so users can see who pushed when and what SPF returned.
